_songs: Guitar Pro files whose notes are known. Paths may start with ~. Copies stay on your PC (cache/ and out/ are not committed).

songs.path: ~/Downloads/Chris Tomlin - Here I Am To Worship.gp
~/Downloads/UG Songs/How He Loves - David Crowder Band (Key C)/How He Loves - David Crowder Band - Guitar Pro.gpx

_seconds: Each song is tested on its busiest stretch of this many seconds (set "start" on a song to pick it).
_pass: Pass marks. A check below its mark fails the song. SDR in dB; F1 from 0 to 1 (1 = every note right); bar_lines = share of the true bar lines the .gp5 has within 80 ms.
_pass_real: Pass marks for real recordings (real.py). Lower: a band doesn't play exactly what the tab says, and the line-up is good to ~0.1 s. Set from the first runs (2026-10-24) minus a margin, so a fail means it got worse.
_drop: A score this much lower than the last run of the same song and model is flagged.
